name: Water Elemental
summary: An elemental of living water that freezes and engulfs foes.

traits.name: Freeze
traits.text: If the elemental takes Cold damage, its {ref:glossary/speed} decreases by 20 feet until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Water Form
traits.text: The elemental can enter an enemy's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The elemental makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.onHit: If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {ref:condition/prone} condition.

actions.name: Whelm

save.targets: each creature in the elemental's space

actions.onFailure: If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc=14}). Until the grapple ends, the target has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition, is suffocating unless it can breathe water, and takes {dmg:2d8:bludgeoning} at the start of each of the elemental's turns. The elemental can grapple one Large creature or up to two Medium or smaller creatures at a time with Whelm. As an action, a creature within 5 feet of the elemental can pull a creature out of it by succeeding on a {dc=14} Strength (Athletics) check.
